I can’t find an NHANES variable named LBXFAKE. It isn’t in the EP‑WAS catalog, and the closest code match is LBXFER (serum ferritin), which is not a PFAS.

If you meant a specific PFAS measured in NHANES, common serum PFAS variable codes include:
- LBXPFOA (PFOA)
- LBXPFOS (PFOS)
- LBXPFHS (PFHxS)
- LBXPFNA (PFNA)
- LBXPFDA (PFDA)
- LBXPFUN (PFUnDA)

Tell me which one you want and I’ll pull the strongest survey‑weighted associations with effect sizes, 95% CIs, and the specific NHANES cycles contributing to the meta‑analysis (and, if useful, the cycle‑by‑cycle estimates).
